message.content: {"criteria":[{"id":"C1","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events."},{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"A newer technology designed by ASU Professor Greg Asner has been used in Hawaii to detect colour/tone changes to the seafloor"}],"reasoning":"Users (marine scientists, conservation) and rationale are identified and referenced via footnotes. However, the mission goals, objectives and requirements (orbit, sensors, coverage, data latency) are not stated explicitly. The concept leans on Asner's technology without a clear mission function statement. Some claims (e.g. 30% acidity) are imprecise and the reef area figure is not justified. Adequate rather than accomplished."},{"id":"C2","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart."},{"where":"Image 1","quote":""}],"reasoning":"A Gantt chart with tasks, deadlines and task descriptions is provided and is feasible. Information sources are listed as links. However, there is no contingency or variation provision, and the plan is not explicitly tied to the mission narrative. The week-by-week mapping of tasks is somewhat inconsistent (e.g. STK simulations start before design is finished)."},{"id":"C3","level":"Adequate","mark":5,"evidence":[{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","quote":"I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii, researched into how coral bleaching occurs and its severity, and also completed STK tutorials 1, 2, 3 & 4."}],"reasoning":"Progress is limited to reading, research and tutorials. No technical results (orbit parameters, STK outputs, calculations, coverage) are presented, so the evidence of technical progress is weak. Minor work only, consistent with adequate."},{"id":"C4","level":"Accomplished","mark":16,"evidence":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","quote":"Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic since the industrial revolution leading to the bleaching of coral reefs."}],"reasoning":"Clear headings, logical structure, numbered footnote references matching the link list, and a well-labelled Gantt chart. Minor issues: 'nurture' wording, inconsistent number style, no figure captions beyond the image, and the reference list is bare links without full citations. Overall professional and readable, so placed in the upper band."}],"requirements":[{"id":"R1","met":"partial","where":"Mission Concept & Rationale"},{"id":"R2","met":"no","where":null},{"id":"R3","met":"no","where":null},{"id":"R4","met":"yes","where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress"},{"id":"R5","met":"yes","where":"Useful Links"},{"id":"R6","met":"partial","where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress"}],"technical_issues":[{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","issue":"Claim that oceans are 30% more acidic is misstated; ocean acidity has increased about 30% (pH drop ~0.1), which is ambiguous as written."},{"where":"Mission Concept & Rationale","issue":"Reef area of 344,400 km² is stated without stating it is the total marine park area rather than reef area."},{"where":"Project Plan & Preliminary Progress","issue":"No space segment design: no orbit type, altitude, inclination, launch vehicle or link budget applying launch/orbit course material (R2)."},{"where":"Useful Links","issue":"Software choice is mentioned only as STK tutorials; no explicit software selection statement is made (R3)."}],"overall":"A readable report with a clear Gantt chart and sources, but the mission concept lacks explicit objectives and requirements, there is no space-segment design (orbit, launch, link analysis), software selection is not stated, and technical progress is only tutorials and reading. Preliminary technical results are needed."}
